project: LBE (Lockstep Boundary Engine) TUI governed coding frontend roadmap
engine_definition: LBE = Lockstep Boundary Engine. The core engine semantics: every step is a locked boundary, and only proven, observed evidence (never assumption) can open it. Authority, authorization, execution, evidence, receipt, and completion truth are gated by this boundary model.

static_gate.warnings_note: Warnings do not invalidate this gate unless the acceptance contract explicitly requires warning-free compilation.

machine_state.do_not_promote: Do not promote to full client integration or installed PTY/ConPTY acceptance yet.

user_facing_cli.name: LBE CLI
user_facing_cli.branding_note: User-facing product is LBE CLI; Cline is the embedded engine that handles auth/providers/models. The Cline engine binary is not renamed. Branding is applied at the launcher/header/documentation level. Cline auth, Cline config, Cline model, and Cline provider commands remain Cline-owned.
